note: PARTIALLY RESEARCHED: the Central African Republic League (Championnat Seniors D1) is confirmed as a 12-club top flight. Only AS Tempête Mocaf could be confirmed as champions for a single named season (2023-24); other clubs surfaced (DFC8, Olympique Ral, Red Star) were champions of different, unconfirmed years, so were excluded per the no-season-mixing rule. Far short of the 6-club minimum needed for a usable entry. Sources consulted: https://globalsportsarchive.com/en/soccer/competition/championnat-seniors-d1-2024-2025/74271 , https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_African_Republic_League , https://www.rsssf.org/tablesc/cafrchamp.html . Requires a follow-up pass to name a single season's full club roster.
